raw: I had a beet and goat cheese salad for dinner, with toasted walnuts scattered over the beets. The walnuts stand out in my memory—the crunch, compared with the soft cheese. And the beets have quite a strong color, so that’s the first picture that comes to mind when I think about it. I also had a slice of buttered rye on the side. Rye has that distinctive taste of its own. I remember the food more clearly than what I was thinking about while I ate.
